(An UGC Autonomous Institute, Accredited by NAAC with ‘A’ Grade)
B. Tech CSE-D III Year II Semester
This project presents Timely Sync, a Smart Deadline and Compliance Management
System that helps students and professionals manage academic, career, and personal
deadlines effectively. It overcomes the limitations of traditional reminder-based tools
by providing intelligent risk scoring, impact simulation, and accountability tracking.
The system supports manual task creation and smart intake from text, PDF, and
images to convert bulk information into structured tasks.
The system follows a modular multi-tier architecture with a responsive
frontend, secure backend, and scalable NoSQL database. It integrates in-app
notifications, timeline visualization, and behavior monitoring for continuous tracking.
By combining academic and career planning in one platform, Timely Sync promotes
disciplined time management and improves overall productivity.

▪Smart Task Intake using OCR and PDF Processing
The system supports document-based task creation by accepting PDF files, images,
and plain text. Using Apache PDFBox and OCR, the uploaded content is converted
into readable text, which is then analyzed to extract task details such as title, due date,
priority, rules, and warnings. This reduces manual task entry and improves
TimelySync includes an intelligence layer that evaluates each task based on due date
pressure, priority, impact, and effort. The system calculates a risk score and classifies
tasks into Safe, Warning, or Critical levels. This helps users identify high-risk tasks
early and take corrective action before deadlines are missed.
The dashboard module gives users a complete productivity overview by showing total
